name: Marketing Assistance Scheme (NSIC)
summary: Supports MSMEs in participating in domestic and international trade exhibitions to showcase products and access new markets, with NSIC bearing part of the participation cost.
administering_ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
benefit_description: Subsidised participation in domestic and international exhibitions/trade fairs organised or facilitated by NSIC, with differential subsidy rates for women, SC/ST and other special-category entrepreneurs.

criteria.description: Applicant must hold a valid Udyam Registration (or its predecessor Entrepreneur's Memorandum Part-II) to be eligible to apply.
criteria.source_quote: Copy of valid Entrepreneur's Memorandum Part-II only.

criteria.description: Applicant must provide proof of their promoter category (e.g. women, SC/ST, backward, minority) if claiming a differential subsidy rate.
criteria.source_quote: Proof in support of the promoter's category or categories (Women, SC/ST. Backward, Minority) etc.

document_requirements.document_name: Udyam Registration Certificate / Entrepreneur's Memorandum Part-II
document_requirements.source_quote: Copy of valid Entrepreneur's Memorandum Part-II only.

document_requirements.document_name: Audited Balance Sheet or Income Tax Returns (last 2 years)
document_requirements.how_to_obtain: Obtain from your statutory auditor or income tax filings for the previous two years.
document_requirements.source_quote: Copies of Audited Balance Sheet or Income Tax Returns for the last two year.

document_requirements.how_to_obtain: Prepare a brief company profile document for the application.

windows.notes: NSIC publishes an annual calendar of domestic and international exhibitions each year that MSMEs can apply against.

benefits.description: Subsidised stall space and participation cost at domestic and international trade exhibitions.
benefits.conditions_for_disbursement: Subsidy applied against the exhibition participation invoice, not paid as cash to the applicant.
